description:
I am an engineering student at UTAS Muscat, Oman, passionate about AI, satellite data, sustainability, and entrepreneurship. I am working on a NASA Space Apps project to help farmers improve crop rotation, soil health, and water efficiency using NASA data.

I welcome motivated teammates interested in solving real-world problems. I am looking for skills in agriculture, data analysis, AI, web development, and UI/UX design. Let’s combine our skills to impactful solution.
summary:
NOVA GALAXY transforms NASA Earth observations into smarter agricultural decisions.

We developed an interactive agricultural decision-support platform that combines satellite data, local soil characteristics, water availability, crop history, and farmer priorities to generate and compare multi-season crop rotation strategies.

The platform features interactive farm mapping, soil and water analysis, an intelligent crop planning engine, and scenario simulations. It helps farmers evaluate suitable crops, understand environmental risks, and compare agricultural plans based on water efficiency, soil sustainability, and expected economic returns.

By addressing the Field Shift challenge, NOVA GALAXY aims to help farmers adapt to climate change, reduce resource waste, lower production costs, and strengthen agricultural resilience, particularly in arid regions such as Oman.

Our innovation bridges the gap between space technology and everyday farming decisions, turning complex scientific data into practical, explainable agricultural intelligence.

Ultimately, NOVA GALAXY aims to empower farmers, strengthen food security, and create a more sustainable and economically resilient agricultural future.
details:
Project Overview

NOVA GALAXY is an intelligent agricultural decision-support platform designed to transform NASA Earth observations and local agricultural data into practical, sustainable, and economically informed farming decisions.

How It Works

The platform allows farmers to define their farm boundaries using an interactive geographic map and enter information about soil conditions, water availability, crop history, and agricultural priorities.

Its intelligent decision engine evaluates crop suitability, agricultural constraints, and resource availability to generate and compare multi-season crop rotation strategies. Farmers can simulate different environmental and economic scenarios and understand the benefits, risks, and trade-offs of each proposed plan.

Benefits and Intended Impact

NOVA GALAXY aims to:

  • Improve agricultural productivity and resource efficiency.
  • Reduce water consumption, production costs, and agricultural waste.
  • Support healthier soil management and climate resilience.
  • Improve farmers' economic decision-making and profitability.
  • Strengthen sustainable agriculture and long-term food security.

Technology and Development

The interactive prototype was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, incorporating geographic mapping, mathematical optimization principles, agricultural decision rules, and data visualization.

The platform is designed around NASA data sources, including POWER, GPM, Landsat, HLS, MODIS, and SMAP, alongside local agricultural information. The current prototype uses demonstration datasets and deterministic crop-sequence analysis, providing a foundation for future live data integration and scientific validation.

Creativity and Innovation

Our innovation goes beyond traditional farm monitoring and single-crop recommendations. NOVA GALAXY explores interconnected agricultural decisions across multiple seasons, combining environmental intelligence, agricultural science, economic considerations, and explainable decision-making within one platform.

Rather than presenting one answer, it empowers farmers to compare alternative strategies and choose the most suitable plan for their circumstances.

Factors Considered

Our multidisciplinary team considered soil properties, salinity, water scarcity, climate variability, crop compatibility, planting seasons, agricultural costs, expected returns, data reliability, and farmer accessibility.

We placed particular emphasis on the challenges facing arid regions such as Oman, while designing a framework that could be adapted to other agricultural environments worldwide.

NOVA GALAXY bridges the gap between space-based science and real-world agricultural decisions, helping build a more sustainable, resilient, and economically viable future for farming.
